name: Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker
oracle_text:
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
You may pay eight {E} rather than pay the mana cost for permanent spells you cast.
blocked_sentences: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
You may pay eight {E} rather than pay the mana cost for permanent spells you cast.

needs.what: a per-player energy counter pool (122.1f): an op that gives a player N energy ({E}), and a cost key `pay_energy: N` usable in a cost spec (activated ability or alternative cost) that is payable only when the player has at least N energy and removes it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters only puts counters on objects (amount, counter, objects); add_poison is the only player counter and is poison-specific; no cost key removes counters from a player (remove_counters / remove_counters_from_among read permanents) and no value key reads a player's energy total

needs.what: a player-wide static that offers an alternative cost (any cost spec, here `pay_energy: 8`) instead of the mana cost for every spell its controller casts that matches an `affects_spells` filter (here permanent spells: any_types Artifact, Creature, Enchantment, Planeswalker, Battle; lands are never cast) — 118.9, chosen at cast, mana value unchanged
needs.why_existing_wont_do: alternative_cost is card-level and applies only to the card that carries it; free_cast_permission casts without paying any cost rather than for a different price; spell_cost_reduction only discounts generic mana and cannot replace the cost with a non-mana payment
